Game Overview

In Ouka Bunny Girl 2, the core idea is straightforward: guide a nimble bunny girl through treacherous traps and crafty enemies to gather every carrot. Master precision jumping across eight increasingly challenging levels, avoiding deadly blades and sneaky guards. Use clever timing and strategic movement to progress in this pixel art platformer full of agility-testing fun.
